text:
### 7.2 Death of Account Holder  
If one joint account holder dies:
- Surviving holder retains full account access
- Estate of deceased entitled to their share (50%)
- Bank requires death certificate and documentation
name: Chunk 19/42

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder Death Provision
raw_entities.description: Contractual provision governing the rights and obligations when one joint account holder dies. Specifies that the surviving holder retains full account access while the estate of the deceased is entitled to their proportional share (50%), and establishes the bank's documentation requirements including death certificate.
context: If one joint account holder dies
Surviving holder retains full account access

Bank requires death certificate and documentation

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Arrangement
raw_entities.description: A shared account arrangement held by two or more account holders with defined rights upon death of one holder. The surviving holder retains full access while the deceased holder's estate is entitled to their proportional share.
context: If one joint account holder dies
